title: Yu9191/wloc
claim: Yu9191/wloc — 修改 Apple 网络定位（gs-loc）返回坐标 · 支持 Surge / Quantumult X / Loon / Stash · 快捷指令一键设置/恢复定位
why_good: A clever hack to override Apple's Wi-Fi-based location — niche power-user appeal, but it's a proxy script, not a product, and skirts platform rules.
value: Hard to monetize legitimately; the audience is small and privacy-hobbyist, and app stores/Apple would resist a paid version.
risk: Grey-area location spoofing, fragile against Apple changes, and no real business — a utility script, not a company.
pick_reason: The project is a modification tool for existing apps and lacks a clear monetizable product.
